title: 第6章 风城往事六第7章 风城往事七
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
一间小客栈内，苏天在床上醒来。
“这是哪？”苏天迷茫的看着四周陌生的一切。
昨天，苏天从满堂彩中跑出来之后，一路跑在一个小巷里哭，后来哭累了，就睡着了，醒来就在这了。
“你醒了。”
房门打开，一个少女走了进来。
“师傅，他醒了。”少女冲外面喊道。
“好，我来了。”
一个一身黑衣的中年大叔走进来。
“你们是谁。”苏天问道。
“孩子，你是谁。”男子反问道。
“我……我叫苏天，是苏家的人。”苏天道。
“苏天，你可愿拜我为师。”男子道。
“啊？”苏天有些惊讶。
“不要惊讶，我来风城是有事做，暂住于此，昨夜，我看过你的资质，觉醒了四条经脉，绝对的天才。”男子道。
这还是苏天第一次听到夸奖自己的话，有些愣住了。
“叔叔，你说真的吗。”苏天道。
“放心，我绝对不会骗你，你愿意拜我为师吗。”男子道。
“我愿意！”苏天腾的一声跪在地上。
“苏天拜见师傅！”苏天磕了三个响头。
“哈哈哈，好，好，好。”男子开心的把苏天扶起来。

“来，认识一下，这是你的师姐，高婷。”男子介绍道。
“苏天拜见师姐。”苏天行礼道。
“嗯。”高婷点了点头。
“你们，进来。”男子招了招手，门外走进来俩个壮汉。
“他们是我此行的贴身护卫，一个叫尹三，一个叫尹四，是亲兄弟，从现在开始，他们属于你，除了我们俩个，他们谁的话都不听。”男子道。
“谢师傅！”苏天非常开心，此刻，他好像有了点依靠。
苏家。
“桃儿，该醒了，太阳照屁股喽。”
苏少卿走进房间，在苏桃儿的屁股上轻轻的打了一下。
“啊，哥！你干嘛，打疼我了。”苏桃儿睁开眼，皱着眉盯着苏少卿。
“桃儿，怎么了。”
门外，何倩的声音传来。
“娘，我哥打我！”苏桃儿见何倩过来，一路小跑着奔向何倩，向何倩告状。
content_en:
In a small inn, Su Tian woke up in bed.
"Where is this?" Su Tian looked at the unfamiliar things around him in confusion.
Yesterday, after Su Tian ran out of Mantangcai, he ran all the way in an alley and cried. Later, when he was tired of crying, he fell asleep and woke up here.
"You're awake."
The door opened and a girl walked in.
"Master, he's awake." The girl shouted outside.
"Okay, here I come."
A middle-aged man dressed in black walked in.
"Who are you?" Su Tian asked.
"Child, who are you?" the man asked.
"I...my name is Su Tian, ​​and I am from the Su family." Su Tian said.
"Su Tian, ​​are you willing to worship me as your teacher?" the man said.
"Ah?" Su Tian was a little surprised.
"Don't be surprised. I came to Fengcheng to do something and I am staying here temporarily. Last night, I saw your qualifications and awakened four meridians. You are an absolute genius." The man said.
This was the first time Su Tian heard praise for himself, and he was a little stunned.
"Uncle, are you serious?" Su Tian said.
"Don't worry, I will never lie to you. Are you willing to become my teacher?" the man said.
"I do!" Su Tianteng knelt on the ground with a cry.
"Su Tian pays homage to the master!" Su Tian kowtowed three times.
"Hahaha, okay, okay, okay." The man happily helped Su Tian up.
"Come, let's get to know each other. This is your senior sister, Gao Ting." The man introduced.
"Su Tian pays homage to senior sister." Su Tian saluted.
"Yeah." Gao Ting nodded.
"You guys, come in." The man waved, and two strong men walked in from the door.
"They are my personal guards on this trip. One is called Yin San and the other is Yin Si. They are brothers. From now on, they belong to you. Except for the two of us, they will not listen to anyone else." The man said.
"Thank you, Master!" Su Tian was very happy. At this moment, he seemed to have some support.
Su family.
"Tao'er, it's time to wake up, the sun is shining on your butt."
Su Shaoqing walked into the room and lightly spanked Su Taoer on the butt.
"Ah, brother! What are you doing? It hurts me." Su Taoer opened her eyes and stared at Su Shaoqing with a frown.
"Tao'er, what's wrong?"
Outside the door, He Qian's voice came.
"Mom, my brother hit me!" Seeing He Qian coming, Su Taoer ran towards He Qian and complained to He Qian.
